 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Ms. Jyoti Ranjan Jha, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Akshay Lal Pandit, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 08-01-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends her arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 86C of 2024 (arising out of Lakhisarai Mahila P.S. Case No. 73 of 2023) in which cognizance has been taken for the offences punishable under Sections 323 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Lakhisarai Mahila P.S. Case No. 73 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Based upon the complaint case, it is alleged that the marriage of the complainant was solemnized with one Saurabh Kumar on 19.04.2018.
Soon after the marriage, there was demand of dowry and on account of non fulfillment of the same, she was tortured in various ways.

It is further alleged that said Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.89267 of 2024(2) dt.08-01-2025 Saurabh Kumar had illicit relationship with the petitioner, who is said to be aunt of Saurabh Kumar.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner contented that the entire case is based on suspicion of illicit relationship.
The allegation of torture and demand of dowry revolved around the husband of the complainant and other family members.

The petitioner has no concern with the affairs of the Ponam Devi @ Punam Devi @ Poonam Devi vs The State Of Bihar on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196512630/
1 complainant and her husband.

entities.text: Ponam Devi @ Punam Devi @ Poonam Devi vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned jurisdictional court after examination of solemn affirmation and evidences of the enquiry witnesses, has taken cognizance only under Sections 323 and 498A of the I.P.C.

There is a matrimonial case for restitution of conjugal right pending before the Principal Judge, Family Court, Munger under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act duly filed by the husband of the complainant.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application.

6. Regard being had to the submissions made on behalf of the parties and considering the nature of allegation, which is based upon suspicion, coupled with the fact that the petitioner is aunt of the complainant's husband having fair antecedent, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail,
in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.89267 of 2024(2) dt.08-01-2025 period of four weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Lakhisarai in connection with Complaint Case No. 86C of 2024 (arising out of Lakhisarai Mahila P.S. Case No. 73 of 2023), subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C, with further condition that one of the bailors shall be the own/close family members of the petitioner.

(Harish Kumar, J) rohit/-
